title: 第一卷 第3章 周皇 要不就给他试试第一卷 第4章 周皇的执行力又赐婚了
slug: 自曝万嗣呈祥父皇给我疯狂赐婚
content_zh:
御书房内，死寂无声。
赵道霆的呼吸都停了。
一本通体泛着淡金光泽的典籍，就那么凭空出现在赵辰安的掌心。
没有储物法宝的灵力波动，没有丝毫空间涟漪。
就像是……神迹。
赵道霆一生征战，身为大周帝王，自认心如铁石，此刻指尖却传来一阵冰凉的麻意。
他那双阅尽世间沧桑的眼眸，第一次出现了无法掌控的收缩。
这不是神通。
这是他无法理解的法则！
《大道天衍经》。
仅仅是封面上那五个古字，就让赵道霆的神魂一阵刺痛，仿佛在仰望一片无法揣度的星空。
这逆子，从哪里得来的这东西？
是福？
还是能将整个大周王朝拖入深渊的滔天大祸？
属于帝王的威压轰然降临，却因为主人心绪的剧烈波动而显得不稳。
赵道霆死死盯着赵辰安，声音是从牙缝里挤出来的。
“此物，何来？”
他第一个念头，不是占有，是恐惧。
能拿出这等物品的存在，碾死他这个小小的“王朝”
帝王，比碾死一只蚂蚁还简单。

自己的儿子，平日里斗鸡走狗，怎么会沾染上这等恐怖的因果？
莫不是被哪个万年老怪当成了棋子？
面对父皇几乎要噬人的目光，赵辰安的脸上却恰到好处地浮现出茫然与激动。
他摊开手，仿佛自己也无法解释。
“父皇，儿臣不知。”
“昨夜大婚后，儿臣梦入混沌，有宏大之音告知，儿臣激活了上古大能遗留的传承。”
赵辰安按照早已演练无数遍的说辞，语气真诚。
“那传承规则……很奇特。
只要儿臣迎娶的妻子资质越是绝佳，诞下的子嗣越是不凡，便能获得越丰厚的传承奖赏。”
“这本功法，便是儿臣醒来后，脑中多出的第一份赏赐！
儿臣不敢隐瞒，立刻前来禀告父皇！”
说完，他一脸坦荡地看着赵道霆，像个第一时间向家长献宝的孩子。
御书房内，落针可闻。
赵道霆的目光如刀，一寸寸剐过赵辰安的脸，试图找出哪怕一丝一毫的心虚。
没有。
只有坦诚，和尚未从天降横财中回神的懵懂。
突然！
“荒唐！”
赵道霆勃然大怒，一掌拍在御案上，坚硬的紫檀木应声浮现一道裂纹。
“上古传承？娶妻变强？赵辰安！

你当朕是三岁孩童吗！”
content_en:
In the imperial study room, there was deathly silence.
Zhao Daoting's breathing stopped.
A book with a light golden luster appeared in Zhao Chenan's palm out of thin air.
There is no spiritual power fluctuation from the stored magic weapon, and there is no ripple in the space.
It's like...a miracle.
Zhao Daoting has been fighting all his life. As the emperor of the Great Zhou Dynasty, he thought that his heart was as stone as stone, but at this moment, he felt a cold numbness on his fingertips.
His eyes, which had seen the vicissitudes of the world, shrank uncontrollably for the first time.
This is not magical power.
This is a law he cannot understand!
"Dao Tian Yan Jing".
Just the five ancient characters on the cover made Zhao Daoting's soul sting, as if he was looking up at an incomprehensible starry sky.
Where did this traitor get this thing?
Is it a blessing?
Or is it a catastrophic disaster that can drag the entire Zhou Dynasty into the abyss?
The pressure of the emperor came suddenly, but it seemed unstable because of the violent fluctuations in the master's mood.
Zhao Daoting stared at Zhao Chenan, his voice coming out from between his teeth.
"Where did this thing come from?"
His first thought was not possession, but fear.
Beings who can produce such items will crush his little "dynasty" to death
An emperor is easier than crushing an ant.
How could his own son, who was usually a lackey in cockfighting, be contaminated by such horrific consequences?
Could it be that he was used as a pawn by some thousand-year-old monster?
Facing his father's almost gnawing gaze, Zhao Chenan's face showed just the right amount of confusion and excitement.
He spread his hands, as if he couldn't explain it.
"Father, my son and I don't know."
"After the wedding last night, I dreamed of falling into chaos, and a majestic voice told me that I had activated the inheritance left by the ancient power."
Zhao Chenan followed the words he had rehearsed countless times and sounded sincere.
"The inheritance rules... are very strange.
As long as the wife the son marries has excellent qualifications and the more extraordinary the children he gives birth to, the richer inheritance rewards will be obtained. "
"This skill is the first reward that comes to my mind after I wake up!
The son did not dare to hide it, so he immediately came to report to his father! "
After saying that, he looked at Zhao Daoting with a magnanimous expression, like a child who immediately presented a treasure to his parents.
In the royal study room, you can hear a needle drop.
Zhao Daoting's gaze was like a knife, slicing across Zhao Chenan's face inch by inch, trying to find even the slightest hint of guilt.
No.
There is only frankness and ignorance that has not yet recovered from the windfall.
Sudden!
"Absurd!"
Zhao Daoting was furious and slapped the imperial case with his palm, causing a crack to appear on the hard rosewood.
"Ancient inheritance? Marry a wife and become stronger? Zhao Chenan!
Do you think I am a three-year-old child? "
